resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1930 in Idaho Fire Lookouts and Forest Lookouts (and the brief); 1931 in Firelookout.com and the Forest Service list, which give the year against the L-4 cab. Used 1930 and stated both in the story.
Removed in 1963 per Idaho Fire Lookouts and Forest Lookouts; destroyed in 1963 per Firelookout.com and the Forest Service list. Same year in all four sources; wording differs.
6,367 feet in Firelookout.com and the Forest Service list; 6,844 feet in Idaho Fire Lookouts. Not stored in facts; both stated in the story.

Nez Perce-Clearwater National Forest in Forest Lookouts; Clearwater National Forest in Firelookout.com; Kanisku National Forest in Idaho Fire Lookouts. Used Nez Perce-Clearwater, which matches the brief and Forest Lookouts; the story names the Clearwater and Kanisku variants.

notes_for_editor: Built year: brief 1930 kept; Forest Service list and Firelookout.com say 1931 for the L-4 cab. Idaho Fire Lookouts' sentence that the L-4 style was built from 1929 to 1953 describes the design, not this lookout, so it is not used. Elevation and forest-name conflicts are noted above. Staffing is one name for 1960 from Idaho Fire Lookouts' Known Staff section; not corroborated. No photo URLs were added; the 1931 Louis Hartig photo is credited to the Nez Perce-Clearwater archives in two sources but no image URL was read.
